newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EC Commission draws up Balkan guidelines.
newsitem.headline: EC Commission draws up Balkan guidelines.

text.p: European Union External Affairs Commissioner Hans van den Broek said on Wednesday any future ties between the EU and the Balkan republics would be conditional on full implementation of the peace accords.

Outlining principles to govern relations, van den Broek said they would be conditional on full implementation of the Dayton peace agreement, particularly respect of human rights and right of return for refugees.

"We won't even talk unless we are convinced that Dayton is being implemented -- fully and royally. We feel these countries cannot ask from us what they would deny their neighbours," he told a press conference.
The framework which would provide the basis for any trade deals between the European Union and Bosnia, Croatia, the rump Yugoslavia, Macedonia and Albania must now be approved by foreign ministers.
